newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria holds three bank officials in fraud case.
newsitem.headline: Algeria holds three bank officials in fraud case.

text.p: Algeria, cracking down on corruption ahead of June 5 parliamentary elections, has arrested three managers of a state-owned bank suspected of embezzling and fraud, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Thursday.
It said the chief executive and two deputies in the Bank of Agriculture and Rural Development in the eastern region of Skikda appeared before a judge and were ordered held pending trial.
APS said they were accused of "embezzlement and squandering public and private funds" and of doctoring commercial documents and destroying receipts and cheques.
Authorities have issued a stream of charges and jail sentences involving officials in state-run companies since President Liamine Zeroual pledged in late 1995 to wipe out corruption.
